description:
In a multinational company's annual audit process, the audit coordinator initiates the audit process by sending a notification to the regional office.
The regional office prepares financial statements and gathers necessary documents.
Concurrently, the compliance team checks for any regulatory updates that might affect the audit.
Afterward, the regional office submits the documents to the central audit team.
The central audit team reviews the submission.
If discrepancies are found, they request clarifications from the regional office.
The regional office provides the necessary clarifications.
Once all documents are reviewed without issues, the audit team conducts a risk assessment.
The risk assessment includes evaluating financial risks, operational risks, and compliance risks, which can be done in any order but must all be completed.
If high risk is identified, then a detailed investigation is launched.
The investigation includes data analysis, interviews, and, in certain cases, site visits.
After all risks are addressed, the audit team compiles the audit report.
The report is reviewed by the audit director.
The audit director may approve the report or send it back for revisions.
If revisions are required, the audit team updates the report accordingly and resubmits it to be reviewed again by the audit director.
Once approved, the final report is distributed to the executive board and archived.
The entire audit process is then closed.

      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditTeam" name="Central audit team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConcurrentWorkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnalyzeData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductInterviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SiteVisitRequired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductSiteVisits</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SiteVisitMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InvestigationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FinalActionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FinalActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Audit" name="Annual audit initiated"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkSplit" name="Begin notification and regulatory check"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send notification to regional office" messageRef="Message_AuditNotification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check for regulatory updates"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSubmission" name="Receive documents from regional office" messageRef="Message_DocumentSubmission"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancies" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoDiscrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestClarification" name="Request clarifications from regional office" messageRef="Message_ClarificationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveClarifications" name="Receive clarifications from regional office" messageRef="Message_ClarificationResponse"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" name="Assess all risk areas"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin" name="All risk areas assessed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzeData" name="Analyze data"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductInterviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitRequired" name="Site visits required?" default="Flow_NoSiteVisit"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSiteVisits" name="Conduct site visits"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" name="Continue investigation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationMerge" name="Risk assessment and any investigation complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportDecision" name="Approve report?" default="Flow_ReportRevisions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report for revisions"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" name="Distribute and archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DistributeReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board" messageRef="Message_FinalReport"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin" name="Final report distributed and archived"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConcurrentSplitToCompliance" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplianceToConcurrentJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmissionToConcurrentJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDiscrepancies" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancies"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">discrepanciesFound = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToReceiveClarifications" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarification" targetRef="Task_ReceiveClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarificationsToReview" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveClarifications" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToFinancial" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToOperational" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToCompliance" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinancialToRiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OperationalToRiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" name="No high risk identified" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewsToSiteVisitDecision" sourceRef="Task_ConductInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitRequired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitRequired" name="Site visits required" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitRequired" targetRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">siteVisitsRequired = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSiteVisit" name="No site visit required" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitRequired" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitMergeToInvestigationMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvestigationMergeToCompile" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DirectorReviewToDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportDecision"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportRevisions" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportDecision" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalSplitToDistribute" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_DistributeReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalSplitToArchive" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeToFinalJoin" sourceRef="Task_DistributeReport" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchiveToFinalJoin" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalJoinToClosed" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin" targetRef="End_AuditClosed"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RegionalOffice" name="Regional office audit activities" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RegionalOffice">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RegionalNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFinancialStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_DocumentsSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ClarificationRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RegionalNotification" messageRef="Message_AuditNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" name="Prepare financial statements"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team" messageRef="Message_DocumentSubmission"/>

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide necessary clarifications"/>
